name: Summit AZ - Drain Cleaning City Pages
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-10-03

# Summary
Rewrite drafts for four drain cleaning city pages. Each draft maps new text to the existing Elementor widgets (layout untouched), sets new Rank Math fields, removes unapproved claims and lists every local fact with its source. The Sep 25 drafts were applied live Sep 24 to 25 per the handoff and case study; Fountain Hills was applied Oct 3 in the striking-distance batch.

# Pages
| City | Page ID | Draft file | Problem before | Main keyword | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tempe | 5383 | `Summit-AZ-Drain-Cleaning-Tempe-Draft-2026-09-25.md` | Discovered not indexed; 50% same as Queen Creek | professional drain cleaning (1,600 / KD 22) | Live Sep 25 |
| Queen Creek | 5467 | `Summit-AZ-Drain-Cleaning-Queen-Creek-Draft-2026-09-25.md` | Crawled not indexed; 50% same as Tempe | drain cleaning services (9,900 / KD 16) | Live Sep 25 |
| Scottsdale | 6144 | `Summit-AZ-Drain-Cleaning-Scottsdale-Draft-2026-09-25.md` | Crawled not indexed; 55% same as San Tan Valley | drain cleaning Scottsdale (110 / KD 5) | Live Sep 25 |
| Fountain Hills | 5902 | `Summit-AZ-Drain-Cleaning-Fountain-Hills-Draft-2026-10-03.md` | Position 8 to 11 on six searches, 0 clicks; 40% shared copy | drain cleaning Fountain Hills (GSC position 8) | Live Oct 3 |

# Common fixes
- "Same Day Service" trust box became "Upfront Pricing"; same-day and emergency FAQs removed or reworded to "most calls, Mon to Sat 8 to 5".
- Flat-rate, fixed-price and "no diagnostic charge" answers replaced with a no-price answer plus "Contact us for a free estimate".
- Septic mentions, unsourced tree-root claims and unconfirmed neighborhoods removed (Encanterra, Ironwood Crossing, San Tan Heights for Queen Creek).
- FAQ accordion and hand-coded FAQPage schema rewritten together so they stay in sync.

# Local sources used
- Tempe: City of Tempe residential fats, oils and grease guidance and the free Fat Trapper.
- Queen Creek: Town of Queen Creek sewer facts (cleanouts, grease, roots, wipes).
- Scottsdale: City of Scottsdale sewer page (city owns the main, homeowner owns the lateral).
- Fountain Hills: Fountain Hills Sanitary District.

# Decisions and status
- Oct 9 Guardian review: Tempe indexed; Queen Creek and Scottsdale still crawled-not-indexed (last crawls in July) but PASS. Oct 7 boost added question H2s and same-city Related Services on Queen Creek and Scottsdale.
